notes: Sheet is drawn rotated (north arrow points to the upper right). Ammond Avenue is one winding road: house numbers run continuously 4400/4401/4406 (narrow NW-SE leg at the left edge) - 4421, 4431 (along the creek) - 4440-4453 (NE leg, AMMOND AV. label) - 4478/4479 (ESE leg, printed 30') up to Colerain; the NE leg is 30', the creek-side leg 33' with the creek running in it. Chase Av. has two legs, both labelled CHASE AV.: a 25' north leg (x~6272-6426, house no. 1961) and a 60' SSE leg; they meet Virginia ~400 px apart, so recorded as two T's; the north leg is named 'Chase Avenue (north leg)' to keep them apart. Virginia continues east past Chase off the sheet; printed 40' near Colerain and 45' near Chase. Jerome Av. meets Chase near the east edge; whether Jerome continues east of Chase is off the sheet, so recorded as T. Hanfield printed bare (60'). Long-dash line across the left half at y~3085 and the dash-dot Corporation Line are not streets. Unnamed narrow lane (~14 ft, no printed width) runs SSE from Jerome's SE face off the bottom edge.
